Purpose of the Role :

Optimize engine parameters in EFI system to achieve targeted performance, fuel efficiency, and regulatory compliance. This role requires hands-on testing, dataset management, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to meet project objectives and enhance overall product quality.

Role Description

·

  1. Perform EMS calibration for 2W gasoline engines, including sensor/actuator characterization, fuelling/ignition optimization, drivability tuning, emission compliance, and OBD calibration.

  9. Document calibration processes, test results, and lessons learned to support standardization and knowledge sharing.

  10. Ensure safety compliance and contribute to enhance performance and profitability by generating value-added ideas

Functional competency

  1. Understanding of gasoline and alternate fuel engine combustion processes

  2. Comprehensive knowledge of engine management SW and control systems(Software)

  3. Familiarity with engine management system components and their functions(Hardware)

  4. Expertise in calibrating engine parameters in EFI systems to achieve performance, fuel efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

  5. Proficiency in quality management tools (e.g., FMEA, QC)

  6. Knowledge of automotive safety standards and Emission/OBD regulations

  7. Strong analytical and data interpretation skills

  8. Ability to perform patent analysis and support innovation activities
